title: Arcane Resistance
summary: Arcane Resistance is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a chance to resist a  Toxin status effect entirely.
extract:
Arcane Resistance is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a chance to resist a  Toxin status effect entirely.
Can be sold for  500.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing or capturing the Eidolon Teralyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Venus Proxima or Veil Proxima missions.
Sometimes offered as weekly rewards for completing Infernums in The Descendia.

History
Arcane Resistance was first introduced in the Trial mission The Law of Retribution, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Resistance from Little Duck for 1,500  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Resistance from Father for 300  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Resistance from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 3  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Resistance from Ordis for 1  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 2 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.

Notes
A Rank 5 Arcane Resistance provides total immunity to  Toxin procs.
